title: Working calendars ③: formula functions addWorkingDays / workingDaysBetween / addWorkingHours
body:
③ maintainer-directed task · Source: maintainer ruling on #35340 (comment https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/35340#issuecomment-7000950747; sub-cards approved 2026-11-19 06:03Z 「同意」「都是 p1」).

**Blocked by #35354** (ADR) and the calendar service in ②. Ships in the same release as ② and ④ (#13655 constraint: no calendar without its formula surface).

## 维护者速读
- **问题：** 公式里没法算「两个工作日后」或「两个日期之间有几个工作日」。
- **要做：** 加三个工作日公式函数，按平台日历计算。
- **不做会怎样：** 日历建好了没人读，按 ADR-0049 是空摆设；各套件继续各算各的。
- **你要做的：** 无。

## Scope
- Add `addWorkingDays(date, n, calendar?)`, `workingDaysBetween(a, b, calendar?)`, `addWorkingHours(datetime, h, calendar?)` to the formula stdlib (`packages/formula`). Calendar resolution per the ADR: explicit code → org default → refuse.
- Synchronous evaluation: the calendar is preloaded into the evaluation bindings, with cache invalidation when calendar rows change.
- Pushdown refuses these functions (filter/aggregate), with a lint pointing authors to a write-time datetime column compared with `{now}`.
- Hook/flow access if the sandbox needs a host function (check the sandbox surface; not assumed).
- Docs and skills teaching text for the three functions.

## Done when
Functions evaluate correctly across a weekend, a National Day week and a 调休 make-up Saturday; pushdown refuses them with a clear error; teaching text updated.

## Non-goals
SQL-side calendar math, date macros in filters (later card).
